description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant on Nicol Street in Nanaimo, offering burgers, breakfast, McCafé coffee, and a full menu with drive-thru and curbside pickup options. Part of a national chain with over 1,400 Canadian locations, this outpost serves as a reliable, predictable food stop in central Nanaimo. Touring cyclists will find quick, accessible meal options and a familiar environment for regrouping.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm drive_through=yes, takeaway=yes, internet_access=wlan, and internet_access:fee=no. The website corroborates the Nanaimo 193 Nicol Street location and explicitly mentions Drive-Thru, Curbside, and McDelivery services, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike racks, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: Wi-Fi not confirmed via website content despite OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no; marked null per evidence rules.
Phone number present in OSM but not surfaced in fetched website content; contact_confirmed.phone left null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A functioning, well-known fast food stop in Nanaimo that offers reliable takeout food and beverages; useful as a resupply point for touring cyclists passing through the area.

wow_evidence: national chain with over 1,400 Canadian locations
